import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 1:
        x = int(data[1])
        print(x)
        return
    
    s = []
    for i in range(n):
        h = int(data[1 + i])
        s.append(h)
    
    s.sort()
    print(s[(n - 1) // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
